concept: ELB: ALB for L7 path-based routing
tests: Which load balancer routes requests to different target groups by URL path.
expected: Application Load Balancer with path-based listener rules (/api → one target group, /images → another). Triggers: "route based on URL path", "different target groups".
why_not: NLB works at L4 with no notion of path; Classic LB has no content-based routing; Route 53 weighted splits traffic by weight, not path.
